scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying SunFounder
scenes.say: Buying a SunFounder Raspberry Pi kit? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: The Raspberry Pi is not included
bullets: Pironman cases also need an SSD
scenes.say: One. The Raspberry Pi is not included. That goes for the Pironman cases, PiDog and PiCar X. The Pironman cases also need an SSD and a twenty seven watt power supply.

scenes.title: Free, but from China
scenes.say: Two. Shipping is free, but it comes from China. Airmail takes seven to fourteen working days, so check duties at checkout.

scenes.title: Read the return policy
bullets: 15 days on the returns page (30 elsewhere)
scenes.say: Three. The returns page gives fifteen days, though other pages mention thirty, and you pay return shipping unless it's defective. Confirm before you order.

scenes.title: Well rated: 4.7/5 on Trustpilot
scenes.say: The good news: SunFounder is rated four point seven out of five on Trustpilot. Our full review is on WiseChoice K R dot com.
